meta.title: 10x Tree Engineering — Achievement Tree
meta.goal: Engineered trees with ~10x faster wood accumulation (dry biomass/year or merchantable stem volume/year), with a manufacturable bio-stack that iterates like software.

nodes.title: Metric + Baseline Lock
nodes.description: Choose 2–3 species (one fast model system, one forestry target), define baseline growth curves, and lock the exact KPI.
nodes.doneWhen: Species chosen; baseline growth curves defined; KPI locked (e.g. stem volume at 12 months in controlled greenhouse, or dry biomass over 120 days).

nodes.title: Assay Environment Lock
nodes.description: Establish a reproducible growth facility with standardised substrate, light, temperature, humidity, watering, and nutrient regimen.
nodes.doneWhen: Reproducible facility running; variance quantified (CV < 15% across replicates for the chosen KPI).

nodes.title: Safety / Regulatory Envelope
nodes.description: Define the containment and deployment class, gene flow strategy, and Australia regulatory pathway assumptions.
nodes.doneWhen: Containment class chosen (greenhouse-only vs field trials); gene flow stance documented; regulatory pathway mapped.

nodes.title: High-Throughput Phenotyping
nodes.description: Automate weekly per-plant metrics: imaging, height, leaf area, stem diameter, optionally NIR biomass proxy.
nodes.doneWhen: Time per plant < 1 min; data versioned and queryable; pipeline running continuously without manual bottleneck.

nodes.title: Root + Nutrient Uptake Measurement
nodes.description: Establish at least one scalable root proxy with repeatability.
nodes.doneWhen: Rhizotron imaging or destructive sampling protocol with quantified repeatability; at least 3 independent replicates validated.

nodes.title: Biomass / Wood Proxy + Ground Truth
nodes.description: Calibrate a non-destructive proxy (stem diameter + allometry, or micro-CT subset) against destructive harvest.
nodes.doneWhen: Proxy R² > 0.90 vs destructive dry weight across at least 30 plants; protocol documented.

nodes.title: Build–Test–Learn Cadence
nodes.description: Bound the cycle time from genetic perturbation to phenotype readout.
nodes.doneWhen: Cycle time bounded: 6–12 weeks in model system (longer in trees compensated via proxies); at least 2 full cycles completed end-to-end.

nodes.title: Growth Equation Factorisation
nodes.description: Decompose growth rate into explicit multiplicative factors with candidate intervention points per factor.
nodes.doneWhen: Written model: growth = f(carbon assimilation) × f(allocation to wood) × f(cambium sink capacity) × f(stress losses); intervention candidates listed per factor.

nodes.title: Bottleneck Ranking with Evidence
nodes.description: Choose the top 3 bottlenecks per species/environment, justified by literature and your own baseline measurements.
nodes.doneWhen: Top 3 bottlenecks documented with quantitative evidence from literature and your own baseline data; intervention priority order set.

nodes.title: Fast Model System
nodes.description: Stand up a fast-cycle plant and demonstrate transformation, expression, and phenotype readout end-to-end.
nodes.doneWhen: Model system chosen (e.g. Arabidopsis/tobacco/fast-cycling poplar); stable transformants produced; reporter or phenotype readout confirmed.

nodes.title: Forestry Target + Transformation Route
nodes.description: Pick target tree species and a realistic engineering method with a credible timeline.
nodes.doneWhen: Target species chosen; transformation method validated (Agrobacterium, somatic embryogenesis, CRISPR delivery); vendor/lab plan with timeline.

nodes.title: Transformation + Regeneration Working
nodes.description: Achieve stable transformants and regeneration at acceptable efficiency in model system; validate at least one path for tree target.
nodes.doneWhen: Model system: >20 independent stable transformants per construct; Tree target: at least one validated low-throughput path.

nodes.title: Promoters / Parts Library
nodes.description: Validate a small set of promoters for key tissue types.
nodes.doneWhen: At least 2-3 validated promoters each for: leaf (photosynthesis), cambium/xylem (wood), root (uptake), and 1 inducible/stress-responsive promoter.

nodes.title: Genome Editing / Integration Strategy
nodes.description: Decide CRISPR vs transgene stacking vs targeted insertion; demonstrate at least one edit with sequencing confirmation.
nodes.doneWhen: Strategy decision documented with rationale; at least one CRISPR edit (KO or KI) or targeted integration confirmed by sequencing in model system.

nodes.title: Stacking + Versioning of Constructs
nodes.description: Standardised construct assembly, naming, and barcode strategy for running 20–50 variants without chaos.
nodes.doneWhen: Assembly standard chosen (Golden Gate, MoClo, Gibson); barcode/naming system in place; can track 20+ variants through pipeline; LIMS or equivalent.

nodes.title: Boost Carbon Input (Source)
nodes.description: Show statistically significant increase in net carbon assimilation or leaf area duration without catastrophic tradeoffs.
nodes.doneWhen: ≥20% increase in net assimilation rate or canopy leaf area duration in model system; no >10% penalty in other growth metrics; p < 0.05.
candidates: C4 pathway modules in C3 plants

nodes.title: Increase Wood Allocation (Allocation)
nodes.description: Increase fraction of fixed carbon ending up in stem/xylem at same or higher total assimilation.
nodes.doneWhen: Stem:leaf dry mass ratio increased ≥30% vs WT in model system; total biomass not reduced; allocation to xylem confirmed by Klason lignin + cellulose assay.
candidates: FT/TFL1 flowering-delay for longer vegetative phase

nodes.title: Expand Cambium Activity (Sink)
nodes.description: Increase cambial cell division markers and xylem deposition rate proxies.
nodes.doneWhen: Cambial zone width increased ≥50% and xylem deposition rate (ring width proxy or tracheid count) increased ≥30%; no runaway uncontrolled growth.

nodes.title: Improve Hydraulics + Nutrient Throughput
nodes.description: Sustain higher transpiration/uptake without hydraulic failure; higher growth under high-demand regimes.
nodes.doneWhen: Stomatal conductance + transpiration rate maintained at 20% higher biomass production; no increased wilting under equivalent VPD.

nodes.title: Stress Tolerance, No Growth Penalty
nodes.description: Maintain growth under heat/drought/pathogen pressure that normally depresses baseline.
nodes.doneWhen: Growth maintained within 10% of unstressed controls under a defined stress regime (specify temperature/drought protocol); WT loses ≥25% under same regime.
candidates: ABA signalling retuning for partial stomatal opening

nodes.title: Causal Dataset
nodes.description: Compile interventions × phenotypes dataset with enough breadth to learn nontrivial structure.
nodes.doneWhen: ≥200 plants across ≥20 distinct genetic variants and ≥3 conditions; data in queryable format; intervention × phenotype matrix complete.

nodes.title: Predictive Models (Genotype → Phenotype)
nodes.description: Model predicts held-out growth metrics better than baseline heuristics; used to prioritise next constructs.
nodes.doneWhen: Model R² > 0.7 on held-out test set for primary KPI; at least one non-obvious prediction validated experimentally.
candidates: Graph neural networks on pathway structure

nodes.title: Control Policies (Environment + Gene Circuits)
nodes.description: Program growth trajectories via inducible circuits and environmental schedules reproducibly.
nodes.doneWhen: At least one inducible circuit demonstrated (e.g. steroid-inducible gene) controlling a growth parameter; environmental schedule (light/nutrient) shown to compound genetic gain.

nodes.title: Wood-in-a-Vat Hypothesis
nodes.description: Define what 'manufacture' means: living trees grown faster, engineered cambium producing lignocellulose sheets, or cell-free enzymatic assembly.
nodes.doneWhen: Hypothesis chosen with written rationale; TEA skeleton (even order-of-magnitude) showing plausible path to <$X/kg; kill criteria defined.
candidates: (B) Engineered cambium tissue producing lignocellulose sheets ex vivo
(D) Synthetic wood composite from plant cell outputs

nodes.title: Plant Cell Culture → Lignocellulose
nodes.description: Establish callus/suspension cultures with measurable cellulose and lignin production; output rate quantified.
nodes.doneWhen: Culture producing ≥1 g/L/day dry cell weight with measurable Klason lignin (≥5%) and crystalline cellulose (XRD confirmed); output rate in grams/L/day documented.

nodes.title: Directed Differentiation → Xylem-like
nodes.description: Induce tracheary element differentiation in culture with consistent markers and measurable deposition.
nodes.doneWhen: ≥30% of cells in culture showing tracheary element markers (secondary cell wall thickening, VND7/NST expression, autofluorescence); deposition rate quantified.

nodes.title: Scale + Bioprocess Economics
nodes.description: Rough TEA: $/kg dry lignocellulose vs alternatives; identify 1–2 parameters that must improve 10–100×.
nodes.doneWhen: TEA completed to ±50% accuracy; identifies top 2 cost drivers; sensitivity analysis shows which parameters must hit what targets for viability.

nodes.title: Greenhouse Replication + Robustness
nodes.description: Top genotype(s) replicate across batches/operators; effect size persists; failure modes characterised.
nodes.doneWhen: Top genotype retains ≥80% of effect size across ≥3 independent batches by ≥2 operators; failure modes documented; CV of KPI < 20%.

nodes.title: Field Pilot Pathway
nodes.description: Plan for contained trials; gene flow mitigation; monitoring; stakeholder strategy.
nodes.doneWhen: Contained field trial plan written; gene flow mitigation strategy (sterility, physical containment); regulatory submission outline; stakeholder map.

nodes.title: Manufacturing + QA for Genetics
nodes.description: Reproducible propagation method, genotyping QC, and trait stability across generations/time.
nodes.doneWhen: Propagation method chosen (seed/clone/tissue culture); genotyping QC protocol with ≥99% accuracy; trait stability confirmed across 2+ generations or 12 months.

nodes.title: Moat
nodes.description: Build defensibility via proprietary parts/datasets/models, process IP, or regulatory/field trial head start.
nodes.doneWhen: At least one of: (a) filed IP on novel parts + datasets, (b) documented unique bioprocess know-how, (c) first contained field trial underway.
